compression_level.description: Compression level for 7z format (0=fastest, 9=best). Passed as --m=<level>.

global_flags.description: List of p7zip switches to apply by default. Supported: -f (force), -k (keep input file), -c (stdout). See p7zip(1) SWITCHES.

archive_extension.description: The file extension used for archives created by the p7zip wrapper.

assume_decompression.description: Whether to assume decompression mode if the file extension matches the archive extension and no explicit action is defined by the invoking script.
